name: community.openwop.checklist-preview
description: RFC 0130 / ADR 0310 Phase E witness: a sandboxed canvas-preview plugin for the Tier-1 pack canvas type `canvas.checklist` (community.openwop.canvas-checklist). Falsifiability: with ui-plugins + canvas-packs on, the checklist editor's center panel is THIS plugin's rendering (an opaque-origin iframe under a deny-egress CSP) — it follows live edits via host.documentChanged, highlights the selected item via host.selectionChanged, and feeds the editor's live region via host.announce; remove the pack and the editor falls back to the generic data view.
